newsitem.title: UK: Greycoat makes 212.5 mln stg disposal.
newsitem.headline: Greycoat makes 212.5 mln stg disposal.

text.p: UK property group Greycoat Plc said on Monday it would sell Embankment Place to Calamander Investments Limited and Sandcliffe Limited for 212.5 million stg in cash.
The sale, which must be approved by shareholders, would enable Greycoat to buy back up to 25 percent of its ordinary shares at 171p, the company said.
"The Embankment Place sale at an initial yield of 7.5 percent significantly reduced our exposure to larger investment properties," Greycoat chief executive Peter Thorton said in a statement.
"We are now well placed in a rising market to take full anvantage of the completion of our development program."
The company said it would hold a meeting on July 17.
The shares closed at 162-1/2p on Friday.
